GAP-0531 sequencing: asset_key is proven against v_ace_asset and v_ace_collateral from Day 1; valuation_key is proven against v_ace_valuation from the week RWB-ACE-001 is deployed and against its contract fake before that week; the appraisal acceptance rows load in both cases; the cutover stays behind its feature switch until the Section B views answer, so no day counts as clean on a STALE DP06 stamp. Owner: solution architect with the ACE team lead and the data steward.

GAP-0529 handover: P1 extracts the listing, the case asset link, the sale instruction and the appraisal acceptance; it loads the appraisal acceptances into valuation_ext idempotently on valuation_key; it hands the listing, the sale and the case asset link to S5 in one package per cutover business date; S5 loads them into rwb_asset on its own sequence. The case asset link rides on the handover row as the case key beside the asset_key and lands in no table of its own. The source tag and the cutover business date ride on the handover row and in the Flyway history description. Owner: solution architect with the data steward and the S5 rwb-asset tech lead.
